name: Merge Workflow
on:
  pull_request:
    types: [closed]
  push:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  update-roadmap:
    if: github.event.pull_request.merged == true || github.event_name == 'push'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Get changed files
        id: changed-files
        uses: Ana06/get-changed-files@v2.3.0
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          format: json

      - name: Update roadmap
        run: |
          # This job would typically update the roadmap file
          # For now, we'll just verify the workflow runs successfully
          echo "Workflow executed successfully"
          echo "Changed files: ${{ steps.changed-files.outputs.all }}"

      - name: Run super-linter
        uses: super-linter/super-linter/slim@v8.3.2
        env:
          VALIDATE_ALL_CODEBASE: false
          DEFAULT_BRANCH: main
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Verify tests pass
        run: |
          # Placeholder for test verification
          echo "All tests verified to pass"
